natalLabels.moonUnknownText: The Moon's exact sign and degree cannot be verified because the birth time is unknown.
natalLabels.moonTail: It is not shown on the wheel, in groups or on rulers.
natalLabels.timeUnknownNote: Birth time unknown: “≈” values assume local 12:00 and are not exact.
natalLabels.compactNote: The chart area is narrow: the wheel shows planet and sign symbols. Sign, degree and minute of every point are listed below; zooming in also writes them on the wheel.
natalLabels.noGroups: No grouped points in this view: every planet is labelled individually on the wheel.
natalLabels.groupsIntro: Clusters that do not fit one by one in their sign segment on the wheel. Sign, degree and minute are always readable here; zooming in also separates them on the wheel.
natalLabels.groupedWhy: They were grouped because they do not fit individually at a readable size in this sign segment.
natalLabels.stripExact: Each point is at its real degree on the ruler; values come from the stored technical data.
natalLabels.axisNote: Real {axis} degree; in the {hs} system it differs from the cusp of house {n} (house {n}: {sign} {deg}).
natalLabels.storedNote: The value is read from the stored technical data; it is not recalculated.
natalLabels.svgTimeUnknown: — birth time unknown; the Moon is not drawn (its position cannot be verified); other positions assume 12:00 and are not exact
natalLabels.groupAria: {n, plural, one {# point} other {# points}} in {sign}: {names}{assumed}. Details in the group area; also opens on tap.
